findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 48.8% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 47.0% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: 7 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 25 top-holder wallets resolve to 7 linked groups holding 19.0% of supply. The largest (11 wallets) holds 9.1%.

findings.title: Linked wallets are selling
findings.detail: Clustered wallets moved out 0.10% of supply in the last 7 days.

findings.title: Smart Money is holding
findings.detail: 25 Smart Money wallets hold 0.90% of supply.
